rationale: Admission requires physically instantiated support, inherited relations, continuity, boundaries and lineage; an action-source label or successful test cannot supply these clauses.
The quantifier domain excludes arbitrary mathematical groupings; R204 can construct models without asserting they are actual admitted tokens.
Nonempty physical support is an admission consequence; feedback accuracy or report is absent from the premise.
Persistence and embedding must both hold; changing a consumer route does not by itself prove local cessation or unchanged local content.
Occurrence identity, type and lineage remain different; a copied predictor or route can preserve type without preserving the numerical source occurrence.
Completeness concerns constitutive organization of the frozen token, not all substrate microfacts and not a chosen finite readout.
Action/source/consumer distinctions survive only if the common signature actually retains their typed relations and transported parameters.
Type quotient identifies isomorphic structures rather than numerical occurrences; a set-sized comparison universe is explicitly required.
The same predeclared pseudometric is used on both type presentations; the choice is not learned from performance and has no unique calibration claim.
A projected state trace can erase source and writer-event distinctions; R204 is an instance of this existing view boundary.
Equal estimates, equal views and equal complete organization are successively stronger claims; no step follows merely from matching outputs.
A body/action consumer may be studied without first finding an exclusive owner; a new self-source predicate must remain target-relative.
Universal tokenwise experiential identity is an axiom with existential commitment; none of the new finite models independently establishes it.
Composition of the two tokenwise isomorphisms gives the type biconditional only in one common complete signature.
The forward direction preserves full experiential type under complete equivalence; it does not assert particular target labels are measured.
A sort-preserving image of the nonempty distinguished carrier is nonempty; no alignment, use, retention or reporting gate enters.
Physical and experiential quotient maps coincide under the fixed geometry; existence of a smooth physical path is not derived.
The nonconceptual-self witness must be an actual member of the same domain; absence of conceptual self is not absence of familiar mineness.
Applying U1 to the supplied witness refutes conceptual-self necessity only on that witnessed domain.
This is dependency bookkeeping about the axiom decomposition, not additional empirical evidence for C1.
A proposed gate can be rejected only with an actual witness inside its claimed domain and with the same target meaning.
Universal basal existence and a same-domain missing gate conflict at the witness; selected human agency is not substituted for basal existence.
A source change outside the selected projection is compatible with complete equality only when every constitutive current consequence is genuinely screened.
An actual perturbation changing a writer or consumer fails the description-only premise; measurement choice is not physical intervention by name.
Present dispositions are included in the equality requirement; an altered transition law cannot be called merely future divergence.
Different numerical lineage may be screened from current complete organization, but an actually constitutive retained history relation prevents that screening.
Changing an analyst label differs from changing a physically encoded and consumed label; the latter can change complete organization.
At fixed complete organization C1 allows no extra full-type difference; this does not erase differences omitted from a finite view.
The invariant is experiential type under a non-disturbing description change, not invariance to a physically executed probe.
The present equality premise carries the result; later evidence cannot retrospectively create a present constitutive difference.
The screened-history conclusion is conditional and does not conflict with R173 history-expanded signatures or R199 operational-clone limits.
Equal present types leave numerical occurrences and lineages distinct, exactly the distinction needed by source/carrier clones.
External reward annotation alone does not change intrinsic organization; installed reward or control circuitry is outside that premise.
The same constituent slots, ports and product construction must transport each isomorphism; arbitrary repartitioning is not allowed.
Whole and parts must each be actually admitted with compatible signatures; a whole's admission does not prove a part is a separate autonomous subject.
A drawn coupling edge is not itself the required complete nonproduct witness; the premise remains independently supplied.
The contradiction proof uses strong tokenwise C1 and product compatibility; it does not compute subject number or a scalar sum of experience.
Macro equivalence is a claim about independently admitted complete macro tokens; lower distinctions must be nonconstitutive for that macro comparison.
The lower-scale comparison has its own tokens and common signature; it cannot silently replace the macro bearer.
Complete macro equivalence transports through C1-W without requiring lower types to be identical.
Contraposition of the type biconditional gives only the lower-token complete-type difference.
The candidate set is invariant under the actual automorphism group; external labels or grounded centers change the setup.
Deterministic equivariance is the selector premise; randomized seeds and added distinguished points are additional structure.
The obstruction needs the entire candidate domain to be one overlapping orbit and a nonempty disjoint output.
Automorphisms preserve an invariant selected set as a set, so selecting one member selects its orbit; this is ordinary symmetry mathematics.
One overlapping orbit cannot be both wholly selected and disjoint; the result does not prohibit centered relations on another input domain.
Actuality of each ancestor/formation comparison is a supposition, separate from historical observation and continuity.
Memberwise U1 gives universal basal nonemptiness on the admitted family without invoking an evolutionary continuity argument.
The same physically justified chain and geometry must be used; experiential smoothness is not inferred from visual resemblance of organisms.
The epsilon-chain transfers pointwise through equal quotient maps; no monotone richness or universal biological chain is established.
Physical continuity is an independent modeling premise and remains separate from binary experience-existence continuity.
This specializes U2 to a supplied continuous physical path; it cannot establish the path itself.
Connectedness is topological, not a loose similarity between a finite list of examples.
Continuity into a discrete two-point space is an additional strong premise; physical continuity alone does not supply it.
The endpoint value must be independently supplied in the same domain; naming a human endpoint is not a derivation.
A continuous image of a connected space in the discrete binary space is a singleton; the supplied endpoint fixes its value.
Fine-chain and continuous-path routes remain alternatives; their physical premises must not be conjoined or erased.
Numerical parameter change and recoding are not automatically complete nonisomorphism; a retained invariant is required.
The type biconditional transfers a grounded complete nonisomorphism; no specified feeling or experiential magnitude follows.
The three-register construction freezes clock, clamps, input and constituent slots; different protocols must not inherit its counts.
Image sizes 2,4,4,8 distinguish unequal ranks only; the two single-link cases require another retained invariant.
The buffered s update is independent of the pair mechanism; this is the selected subprocess law, not whole equivalence.
The finite structures are not automatically actual complete realizations, and whole completeness does not transfer to a different subprocess boundary.
The conditional type application is restricted to pairs actually separated by the stated invariant, leaving the equal-rank pair unresolved by this route.
The sub-process type application is separate from the whole comparison and requires its own complete realization premise.
A finite selected target and its measurement interpretation are separately fixed; no-report and report proxies do not define full Phi.
Equal selected views imply equal targets only under the supplied fiber-constancy bridge; C1 alone does not supply this finite implication.
Reflection is a separate implication and can fail under a lossy target projection even when the forward bridge holds.
Nonrejection is not equivalence; exact or bounded claims require the same predeclared errors, distances and sampling law.
The bridge package contains an independent forward premise; packaging cannot turn it into a C1 consequence.
The two-way package additionally imports reflection; a new source/consumer projection cannot assume that reverse direction.
Changing token, view, target or bridge after observing outcomes makes a new hypothesis rather than rescuing the original one.
A same-view/different-target witness refutes the frozen forward bridge; it need not isolate or falsify the complete C1 axiom.
A different-view/same-target witness refutes reflection, not forward sufficiency or basal existence.
Bridge admissibility and target fidelity must apply jointly to the same source claim and version, not separate favorable examples.
Typed operational reconstruction can omit C1 while retaining its own physical inputs and bridge commitments.
Gate relocation requires U1 plus the rival's same-domain witness; the target cannot silently change to a specific sensory content.
A finite translation receives structural experiential interpretation only after its relations are grounded in actual constitutive organization.
A copied description or remembered part does not satisfy continuing support and lineage of the actual constituent.
P3 retains each continuing actual part and U1 gives its experience; this does not freeze local contents under coupling.
The quotient is total and required for every state and named operation, with fixed timing and boundaries.
Representative independence of successor summaries is both necessary and sufficient for the declared deterministic quotient.
The purported mismatch must use true views/targets or the sound frozen error model; inconsistent estimates alone are insufficient.
Equal targets and unequal views attack reflection only after both sides are established on the frozen comparison.
A single tuple of domain, bearer, time, boundary, signature, view, target and errors prevents scope-switching between twin cases.
Definitions distinguish full organization, views, capability and several self targets; they do not introduce an experience gate or a self detector.
An installed predictor with grounded own-target law differs from a merely accurate abstract decoder; common legal plans are essential.
No fixed candidate rules out only an uncentered deterministic singleton selector; adding a center changes the domain.
The identity family is equivariant given its center; this neither discovers a unique owner nor installs a physical self-model.
The local sensor/predictor protocol and independent external-label protocol use different information; no contradiction arises from differing accuracies.
Exact local prediction coexists with chance external-label guessing; this already limits prediction-to-identity claims relevant to R204/R205.
Fiber constancy and TV radius concern unrestricted decoder existence; half diameter is only a bound and installed resources remain separate.
Containing assembly beta, sensed body sigma and acted-on body tau are distinct frozen relations; this is the central internal predecessor for source/consumer rewiring.
The observable law identifies tau-inverse sigma while simultaneous physical postcomposition preserves it and can change beta-relative attachment.
Record registers are explicitly absent from current control; general autobiographical memory cannot inherit this isolation.
An isolated record copy changes report/provenance without changing attachment; active memory in R155 and R173 lies outside this premise.
Complete isomorphisms must retain genuinely constitutive beta/sigma/tau; an analyst's own-body label does not supply the bridge.
The beta-retaining nonisomorphism transfers through C1 only conditionally and identifies no named ownership feeling.
Only grounded internal K-formulas and transported parameters are eligible; a selected path description does not establish its physical truth.
Formula induction preserves grounded relations tokenwise; the image is a selected relation, not automatically an autonomous process or named feeling.
External L-name assignments may vary while D,Phi,h stay fixed; this is metalinguistic ambiguity, not inverted qualia at fixed complete organization.
Structural transport alone does not choose the familiar-mineness name; actual independent semantic evidence can still constrain the name.
A report protocol is a partial measure on reporters, while report-presence can be a total structural predicate; these must not be conflated.
A measure undefined for nonreporters requires additional extension assumptions; neither zero filling nor universal no-mineness follows.
Body-frame/use and semantic/measurement obligations remain jointly open; no conjunction is established as universal necessary or sufficient mineness.
Existential counterfactual contribution is different from actual episode consumption and from universal indispensability; R204's writer-use bit must not be substituted directly.
The OR witness shows why a null contextual output contrast does not establish absence of a potentially effective route.
A late restored output cannot erase evidence of earlier immediate dependence; the pre-compensation interval must remain explicit.
The metric and intervention family define a disposition relative to declared contexts; weak discriminators and omitted contexts preserve uncertainty about actual use.
This is an assumed actual instance, not the availability of a local theorem schema; the induced connector inputs must remain in scope.
Joint synchronization, admitted inputs, refinement and agreement are explicit AND premises for one connected producer-consumer pair.
The theorem record cannot be inverted to infer the actual compatibility package; dependent uses must retain local and interface witnesses.
The complement connector induces input1 outside both standalone input0 contracts; this refutes the unrestricted composition shortcut.
The effective statement retypes archived LiveUse as evidence, while OnticUse_path is independent; historical proof prose must not reintroduce the old certificate selector.
Baseline tuples match, but the mediator intervention distinguishes the declared laws; evidence is conditional on its actual fidelity.
This is a support record with explicit role bridge and compatibility, not itself an ontic K-relation to transport.
Only the corrected grounded phi_path is transported; stale theta_EBA proof wording is governed by the effective replacement rule.
Each bearer must satisfy its own corrected application; shared selected coordinates neither equate full experience nor rank richness.
Ownership, agency and familiar retention are partial possibly overlapping selected targets; the finite coordinate choices do not identify them empirically.
The complete corrected path premises, including role bridge and parameter transport, are assumed for one actual application rather than inferred from a map node.
Availability is relative to admitted operations; an action outside that family cannot witness it.
Actual same-episode production/monitoring is distinct from option availability; under baseline admission it does imply availability.
RetBind needs an earlier same-lineage occurrence, continued actual trace and present consumer use; current predictor equality or an external biography cannot replace these.
Historical witness prose is not fresh evidence of semantic realizability; effective use proceeds through R175's explicit admitted twin-domain premise.
The effective incoming rule requires the admitted matched-present/different-RetBind pair; equal-input logic then gives only organizational nonidentification.
Grounded history witnesses must belong to the same signature and be transported; a present-only complete state cannot silently include an excluded past occurrence.
The effective correction withdraws all-eight organizational realizability and retains only the G-implies-A six-valuation upper bound, with all-six realizability open.
No amount of matched performance, state-update evidence or route refinement supplies the independent B_fam interpretation.
The G-implies-A implication depends on admitting the actual baseline action in the availability family, not on all conceivable availability definitions.
The name still says models, but effective statement gives only an upper bound; a manuscript must not resurrect all-six realized witnesses.
The domain's two histories are a supplied application premise; definitions or one positive history cannot prove their coexistence.
Admission follows conditionally from the explicit pair premise and does not assign a phenomenal difference.
Target distinction does not require statistical/organizational independence, exclusive partitioning or totality.
Equal selector with different target attacks sufficiency; the reverse pattern attacks injectivity and must remain distinct.
An actual grounded chain is required; ordered labels or a model chain alone do not establish it.
The experiential relata/order are independently admitted rather than copied from the physical chain, which would make prediction circular.
A common finite-chain betweenness map leaves two orientations; this is correspondence mathematics, not a measured content prediction.
Both endpoints must constrain the same map on the same fixed target identities; separate fitting maps do not combine.
The effective meaning is orientation completion of supplied full chains; the positive-content kind label must not override the explicit withdrawal.
The empirical burden still includes target identity and relation admission; it was not reduced to an orientation bit.
Neutral middle labels and endpoint facts deliberately leave the named middle order open; full rank-based identity would leak it.
Two middle permutations satisfy the data while changing the fixed target, despite each having an increasing map from the physical chain.
Actual producer/use occurrences, nonnegative delays and one consumer are fixed; timestamps alone do not establish executed use.
Subtracting use times gives dB-dC-g and the reversal witness; no experienced order is observed by this algebra.
The compensated decoder is stipulated as actually executed within the finite model; analyst recoding alone does not preserve executed content.
Inverse composition preserves the feature; a missing compensator or noninjective channel can destroy it even with source identity fixed.
Singleton sources and one nominated use per source are real restrictions; multiple-source or repeated-use cases require a refined binding.
Provenance and decoded feature jointly form only a functional identity; they do not select familiar mineness or a named quality.
An explicit occurrence sort is needed to preserve multiplicity; equal values or equal relation tuples do not identify numerical events.
Membership includes full constitutive support and accountable boundaries of the frozen actual token, not an arbitrary coarse view.
Grounded inclusion maps on event and occurrence sorts establish shared occurrence; value matching alone supplies no identity map.
Multi-token membership of one occurrence differs from multiple copied occurrences; neither count is an experience measure.
All selected scales require jointly grounded identities and faithful inclusions; source, consumer and whole memberships cannot be assembled from unrelated cases.
One identified occurrence can belong to several actual tokens without numerical duplication of that occurrence.
Matched local values and report can coexist with different occurrence multiplicity; this directly constrains R205 source-copy interpretations.
A synchronizer is an additional whole relation; transmitting a change between two copies does not merge their identities.
The imported gluing result requires grounded overlap and interaction-complete signatures; arbitrary local maps are insufficient.
C1 transports each token-relative occurrence image and coherent structure, not cross-token numerical phenomenal-event identity.
Tokenwise isomorphisms leave cross-token phenomenal individuation and unique subject partitioning unresolved.
This remains an open grounding/identification question and does not serve as a premise that action centering has been established.
